dish: Jamaican jerk plates & Colombian burgers from 50+ trucks
address: 5407 W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy, Kissimmee, FL
w: Kissimmee's 50-truck food-truck park on US-192 — picked by Experience Kissimmee and Atlas Obscura for the 20-stop Latin Culinary Trail (2025); Orlando Weekly covered its National Food Truck Day celebration. Jamaican jerk, Colombian burgers, Brazilian and Mexican trucks.

Orlando Weekly readers voted it Best Sand Lake/Dr. Phillips Restaurant in Best of Orlando 2025; a 20+-year Restaurant Row sushi standby featured by Visit Orlando's Restaurant Row guide (chef-partner Huy Tin).

dish: Veal chop (the one Bob Hope joked about on Carson)
w: Restaurant Row's grande-dame Italian since 1984 — Tasty Chomps' 35th-anniversary profile recounts Bob Hope joking about its enormous veal chops on The Tonight Show, strolling musicians and a Wine Spectator award; Disney Tourist Blog lists it as its fine-dining pick near Disney World.

dish: Prime steaks & fresh-caught seafood with live music
address: 7533 W Sand Lake Rd, Orlando, FL
w: Named in Orlando Weekly's '30 best restaurants a short drive from Orlando theme parks' for its award-winning wine bar, live music, prime steaks and fresh-caught seafood; a Visit Orlando Restaurant Row feature.

dish: Aged USDA Prime steak flame-grilled over citrus & oak wood
w: Orlando Weekly readers placed Charley's 2nd for Best Kissimmee Restaurant (and 2nd for Best I-Drive) in Best of Orlando 2025; Tasty Chomps lists it among Orlando restaurants honored in Wine Spectator's 2025 Restaurant Awards (Best of Award of Excellence). Family-owned Central Florida steakhouse since 1974.

Downtown Kissimmee's wood-smoked BBQ joint (since 2015) opposite Lakefront Park, with weekend live rock/blues on the porch — on Orlando Weekly's '20 Kissimmee hole-in-the-wall restaurants worth the drive' and Experience Kissimmee's downtown live-entertainment picks.

address: Pointe Orlando, 9101 International Dr #2240, Orlando, FL 32819
w: I-Drive's raucous Greek taverna — table-top belly dancing, flying napkins and saganaki flamed tableside (Orlando Weekly's '30 best restaurants a short drive from Orlando theme parks'; long-running Tasty Chomps coverage, 2012–2021).

dish: Roast duck, char siu & siu mai dim sum
w: Cantonese BBQ and dim sum run by Jerry & Jackie Lau (of Michelin-listed Kai Kai) for the Twenty Pho Hour team — Orlando Weekly's review calls Jerry Lau 'a stir fry master' with real wok hei and singles out the siu mai; in Tasty Chomps' 2026 AAPI dining guide.

dish: Whiskey-forward craft cocktails & fresh-ground gourmet burgers
address: 7563 W Sand Lake Rd, Orlando, FL
w: Orlando Weekly readers voted it Best Sand Lake or Dr. Phillips Bar in Best of Orlando 2025 (over Domu and Sixty Vines); Tasty Chomps' 2025 Happy Hour Hit List highlights its 1,000+ whiskies, burgers and Southern comfort food.

dish: Ipswich fried clams & 'wicked good' clam chowder
w: Boston-owned New England seafood tavern on Celebration's lakefront that flies in its clams — profiled by Spectrum News 13's 'Insider' (2019); Disney Tourist Blog calls it the locals' hangout 'straight out of Cheers'.

dish: Fresh Florida seafood with Southern & Latin accents; weekend brunch
address: Laureate Park Village Center, Lake Nona, Orlando, FL
w: Lake Nona's chef-driven New American spot (Exec. Chef Jason Bergeron) built on seasonal Florida produce and seafood — Orlando Magazine 2023 Dining Awards readers' list (#3 Best Outdoor Dining), Tasty Chomps review and brunch features, Visit Orlando listing.
